race.comment: PURE MAC (1) is showing good form this time in, leading last start at Belmont and only just missing over 1650m. Third-up now and he won his maiden when third-up in the past. Tsang's claim comes in handy and he looks poised to strike at this point of the campaign. POINT ROCKS (3) steps out in trip today and should appreciate this easier level of race. Nottle hops on board and while he has drawn wide, he has enough early speed to get across. Can get the job done this time. CLASSIC IMPACT (2) disappointed last start after an impressive run fresh, both in Saturday grade. Third-up now and she drops right back in grade now. The claim comes in handy and she can put her best foot forward. CAPABLE ANGEL (10) has to be included on her recent form with Fiore on board. MAXIMUM IMPACT (12) just missed last time out and has to be included.
